purpose: Validate the three-dimensional baryonic tensor construction and zero-slip line-of-sight photon deflection without opening any spent or sealed lensing image.

three_dimensional_activation.ell: min(|g_N|/||grad g_N||_F, forward physical distance to the 3D grid boundary along g_N)
three_dimensional_activation.h_hat: unit gas-minus-star field direction with total-field fallback
three_dimensional_activation.component_scale_height: projected component RMS radius; a measured-map geometry quantity, not a gravity parameter

selection_rule: The fixed zero-slip photon closure and sole 3D activation construction advance to spent RX J2129 map building only if every normalization, symmetry, mass, activation, parameter, and blindness gate passes.
claim_boundary: The zero-slip metric is a frozen weak-field closure and not yet derived from a covariant action.
Point-mass recovery validates normalization, not the tensor law's observational accuracy.
Projected RMS-radius scale heights are deterministic map geometry but remain an approximate deprojection.
No spent RX J2129 image and no P0633/P0640 target may be used in P0666 development or selection.
